extra.//: Build-time config for core's platform shim. Deliberately EMPTY: unset keys fall through to the production defaults in packages/core/src/data/liveConfig.ts, so a plain build is a working production build. To point at another project, set VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY / VITE_YAHOO_CLIENT_ID / VITE_MARK_FREE in the environment — app.config.js layers them in. See the header there.

plugins.//: Posting a picture in chat (0349). photosPermission is the line iOS shows the first time the app reaches for the library. camera and microphone are OFF ON PURPOSE, and `false` is not the same as omitting them: left unset this plugin ADDS android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO to the manifest and writes both iOS usage strings, so a chat feature would ship the app asking for a microphone. `false` blocks them instead. Chat picks from the library and never opens the camera; if that ever changes, this is the line to change with it.
plugins.photosPermission: Drip Fantasy uses your photos so you can post one in your league's chat.
